classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the required certification that the United States will take specified actions and that the Comptroller General shall receive specified access; the legally consequential certification occurs in this segment itself.
classifications.evidence: I hereby certify that the United States will take those actions specified in section 2(1) and that the Comptroller General shall have the access specified in section 2(2)(C).

classifications.rationale: The executive branch is directed to implement the preceding commitments subject to stated constitutional constraints; this governs discretionary executive implementation rather than itself changing legal rights or dictating a specific later legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: The executive branch shall implement the foregoing in a manner and to the extent consistent with the President's constitutional authority
